log.message: Initial version tracking
Test: self-update roundtrip (no-op, verifying git push)
v3: Star Menu & Startup proxy+UI, Voice Engine proxy+UI, Elevate Media production endpoints+UI, unified KeyPool, local API Origin/CSRF guard, and token/pricing accuracy

v4: Dual-Kind API Loader (Groq LPU Chat vs Google Cloud/Gemini & Anthropic Claude Auto-Update), Topbar Auto-Update Provider+Model Switch, Surgical Patch Pipeline with USD Cost Receipt, and Learning-by-Watching Automatic Split-Screen Engineer Studio
Add complete Key Tester feature with two-tab sidebar UI (⚡ Groq Studio / 🔑 Key Tester) and backend routes for masked key inventory + live multi-provider key testing
v6: renamed to Queen; Firefox BiDi port found by owner
v7: PAUSE / RESUME / STATUS (/api/pause, /api/resume, /api/pause/status), pause.json, chat pause/resume, skill pause-all
v8: pause status time format fix
v9: TRIPLE CHAT, one room for Marko, Queen and Claude (local Claude Code first, API on consent); word TRIPLE in the window
v10: Triple Chat tested: live stream hides <think>, 'Queen, ask Claude' addresses Queen only, status line no longer breaks inside 'keys 1'
v17: CAPI chats (not conversations), new chat always on top (sorted by creation), provider radios Anthropic / Oxyy with own key, credit and cost, RENAME + AUTOMATIC NAME (Haiku)
v18: no broken words (unbreakable units, FlowLayout), chat row buttons START / STOP RENAME CLOSE, draggable remembered divider
v19: list pane squeezes to 230 instead of overflowing at the minimum window width; model row left; chat list dates on one line
v20: chat actions on one line RENAME START STOP CLOSE, NEW CHAT right-aligned after a pipe, CAPI CHATS button gone (list always shown), pipes between logical groups in the headers and status line
v21: a pipe that would start a row is hidden (pipe wraps with its group), the four top tabs are one unit
v22: rows on one baseline (FlowLayout aligns by firstTextBaseline), green outline on the active chat, TOPIC line, CHATS toggle back
v23: CAPI input inside the right pane, list to the bottom, unlimited resizable input (NSTextView) with scroll bar
v24: third provider GOOGLE CLOUD (Gemini API + Claude on Vertex AI, free credit), paperclip / drop / paste file picker with chips, files to Gemini and Claude
v25: Google Cloud = Gemini only (Vertex dormant), CAPI chats bypass Queen and are never trained, per-chat QUEEN: OFF switch, radio switching both ways, credit base $225.31 with expiry 2.12.2026

v26: MASTER / SLAVE pair of CAPI providers (switch beside each radio, PAIR header, /api/capi/pair), master plans / reviews with VERDICT and chooses the slave's model per round, slave executes and reports, Gemini slave gets hands (function-calling tool loop confined to the chat's folder), rounds + cost cap + STOP for both sides

v27: Gemini 404 dead-model recovery (a retired model is replaced by the one the error names, else a same-tier model from ListModels, with a notice line in the chat), a chat's master model/gmodel can be re-chosen later, MASTER MODEL menu retries a failed Gemini list and puts models newer than the default in their own section, the PAIR summary names the master model and the slave model chain, retired gemini-2.5-pro removed from the curated list and prices

v28: Quit guard: every quit (Cmd-Q, Dock, menu, OFF) asks 'Are you sure you want to quit?' with Quit / Cancel; the server and backend stop only after the quit is confirmed (OFF no longer stops them before the question); the updater's swap and system log out / shut down skip the question
